function.name: CalculateTax
function.description: Calculate the income tax based on the annual income, tax rate, and other deductions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

annual_income.description: The annual income of the person. This is a float type value.

tax_rate.description: The tax rate. This is a float type value.

other_deductions.description: Any other deductions. This is a float type value.

message.content:
先把被积函数 \(f(x)=x^{2}\) 积分，得到原函数：

\[
F(x)=\int x^{2}\,dx=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+C .
\]

然后代入积分区间 \([1,\,3]\)，计算定积分值：

\[
\begin{aligned}
\int_{1}^{3}x^{2}\,dx &= F(3)-F(1)\\[4pt]
&=\left(\frac{3^{3}}{3}\right)-\left(\frac{1^{3}}{3}\right)\\[4pt]
&=\frac{27}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\\[4pt]
&=\frac{26}{3}.
\end{aligned}
\]

所以

\[
\boxed{\displaystyle \int_{1}^{3}x^{2}\,dx=\frac{26}{3}\approx 8.67 }。
\]
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "求f(x)=x^2在x=1到x=3的定積分。" They want the definite integral of f(x) = x^2 from x=1 to x=3. So compute ∫_1^3 x^2 dx. That equals [x^3/3]_1^3 = (27/3 - 1/3) = (9 - 1/3) = 8 + 2/3? Wait 9 - 0.333... = 8.666..., which is 26/3? Let's do exact: 27/3 = 9; 1/3 = 0.333...; difference = 8.666... = 26/3. Yes, 26/3.

Thus answer: 26/3 or approximately 8.667.

We can also show steps: integrate x^2 gives x^3/3, evaluate at 3 minus at 1: (27/3 - 1/3) = 26/3.
